description: This file defines an abstract base class and related data structures for text aggregation in the Pipecat framework, used for processing and manipulating text tokens in TTS services.

classes.name: AggregationType
classes.description: An enumeration of built-in aggregation string types such as 'sentence' and 'word'.

classes.name: Aggregation
classes.description: A data class representing an aggregated text segment and its type.

classes.name: BaseTextAggregator
classes.description: An abstract base class for text aggregators that accumulate and process text tokens, used in TTS services.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Abstract property to get the currently aggregated text.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Abstract method to process input text and yield completed aggregations asynchronously.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Abstract method to flush any pending aggregated text at the end of a stream.

methods.name: handle_interruption
methods.description: Abstract method to handle interruptions in the aggregation process.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Abstract method to reset the aggregator to its initial state.
